description: A session-cookie-policy artifact declares secure cookie attributes, session timeouts, and CSRF protection mode for all authentication cookies.

rules.description: Policy must declare app and at least one cookie with name and purpose.
http_only must be true on all cookies to prevent JavaScript access.
secure must be true on all cookies to prevent transmission over HTTP.
same_site must be Strict, Lax, or None.
Session/auth cookies must declare idle_timeout and absolute_timeout.
Cookies with same_site=None must declare an explicit csrf_protection mode.
